# EnsureSpace

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Starts a new page unless at least `minHeight` of body height remains.

This is the orphaned-heading control: wrapping a heading in `new EnsureSpace({ minHeight: 150, child: heading })` guarantees the heading is followed by 150pt of its section rather than stranded at the foot of a page. The child itself is untouched - once the space test passes it renders and paginates exactly as it would unwrapped.

The test is skipped when the cursor is already at the top of the body band: breaking there would produce a blank page without gaining any space.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new EnsureSpace()
new EnsureSpace(options: EnsureSpaceOptions)
new EnsureSpace(minHeight: LengthInput, child?: IElement)
```

## Properties

- [`minHeight`](#minheight): The body height that must remain on the current page for the child to start here.

### `minHeight`

```typescript
minHeight: number
```

The body height that must remain on the current page for the child to start here. Accepts a length: `150`, `'5cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/field-service-property/site-inspection-report`:

```typescript
guard.minHeight = minHeight;
```
